rows.content: M code waiting
rows.reason: 1. Forced pressure detection of pine knife in the process of automatic knife change: the external air pressure does not reach the pressure of pine knife. 2. Air pressure sensor fault
rows.exclusion: 1. Check the external input air pressure. After the pressure reaches the required value, the machine will automatically continue to run without manual operation. 2. Check the working state of the air pressure sensor

rows.content: Alarm for the stroke over the knife instrument
rows.reason: 1, the tool front end exposed length is too long; 2. Fof of instrument knife instrument
rows.exclusion: 1. Reset the system, manually move the Z axis in the positive direction in manual mode, loosen the spindle clamlet and replace the tool. 2. Enter the parameter mode. In IO monitoring, manually press the instrument to see whether the induction signal of the instrument is normal, such as abnormal replacement

rows.content: Without the external air pressure, the machine forces the stop of operation
rows.reason: Without the external air pressure input, the machine is forced to stop working to protect the air-cooled spindle
rows.exclusion: Check whether the air compressor or air pressure line is abnormal

rows.content: Spindle inverter alarm
rows.reason: Spindle inverter failure
rows.exclusion: First, turn off the machine, boot again in 20 seconds, enter the manual screen, and rotate the spindle. If the alarm is not cleared, open the back cover, check the fault code of the frequency converter to take a picture and send it to the manufacturer

rows.content: The instrument is triggered when the instrument is enabled
rows.reason: Fault on the knife instrument signal
rows.exclusion: Replace the knife instrument

rows.content: The security door is not closed and the processing has been suspended. Please close the security door and click the start button to continue the processing
rows.reason: 1. The security door is not closed. 2, the security door lock switch failure
rows.exclusion: 1. Close the safety door 2. replace the security door lock

rows.content: T1 life arrives, replace the T1 tool
rows.reason: The T 1 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Change a new T 1 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: When the T 2 life arrives, please replace the T 2 tool
rows.reason: The T 2 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Replace a new T 2 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: T 3 life arrives, replace the T 3 tool
rows.reason: The T 3 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Change a new T 3 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: When the T 4 life arrives, please replace the T 4 tool
rows.reason: The T 4 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Replace a new T 4 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: When the T 5 life arrives, please replace the T 5 tool
rows.reason: The T 5 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Change a new T 5 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: When the T 6 life arrives, please replace the T 6 tool
rows.reason: The T 6 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Replace a new T 6 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: When the T 7 life arrives, please replace the T 7 tool
rows.reason: The T 7 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Change a new T 7 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: When the T 8 life arrives, please replace the T 8 tool
rows.reason: The T 8 tool life reaches the warning
rows.exclusion: Replace a new T 8 tool, the tool life management interface to reset the tool.

rows.content: Please clean and maintain the machine
rows.reason: Cleaning and maintenance machine warning warning
rows.exclusion: After the cleaning cycle set by the user (default 72 hours) arrives, there will be cleaning and maintenance tips after the startup returns to zero. Please clean the machine and reset the machine to restart the cleaning cycle.

rows.content: Insufficient external air pressure pressure
rows.reason: Insufficient external air pressure input pressure
rows.exclusion: Check whether the air compressor or air pressure line is abnormal

rows.content: llegal illegal number was detected in the knife
rows.reason: The knife bank is abnormal
rows.exclusion: Reset the knife bank

rows.content: The Z coordinate value of the knife point ([longest knife length] plus [safe distance]) exceeds the Z positive soft limit
rows.reason: The knife bank is abnormal
rows.exclusion: Contact equipment manufacturer

rows.content: The entered T instruction is not in the valid range [only 1~69]
rows.reason: T instruction error
rows.exclusion: Check the tool number value of the CAM software.

rows.content: The XYZ axis does not return to zero, so the blade length measurement cannot be made
rows.reason: The machine did not return to zero
rows.exclusion: Back to zero operation

rows.content: The current knife number of the spindle is inconsistent with the specified measuring knife number
rows.reason: The knife bank is abnormal
rows.exclusion: Reset the knife bank

rows.content: The continuous measurement error of the knife length is too large, which may be dirty to the knife instrument
rows.reason: The knife instrument needs to be cleaned or faulty
rows.exclusion: Detection of the knife instrument

rows.content: Touching the instrument while moving quickly, it may be measured longer than [longest knife length]
rows.reason: The tool is too long
rows.exclusion: Check the knife length

rows.content: The knife instrument has been touched before the slow detection, and the [retreat amount] is too small
rows.reason: The knife bank is abnormal
rows.exclusion: Reset the knife bank

rows.content: The difference between the knife length and the system knife length is out of range and may have been worn or broken
rows.reason: Broken broken or broken knife
rows.exclusion: Change the knife

rows.content: No detection signal detected, may be broken or invalid to the knife signal
rows.reason: Broken broken or broken knife
rows.exclusion: Change the knife

rows.content: The value of the long compensation table deviates greatly from the detection value of broken knife, please update the detection value of broken knife
rows.reason: Broken broken or broken knife
rows.exclusion: Change the knife

rows.content: The empty knife is abnormal and may fail
rows.reason: The knife bank is abnormal
rows.exclusion: Reset the edge of the store to check the tool on the store

rows.content: The instruction knife number is not in the range T 0 to T 8
rows.reason: Enter the wrong knife change instruction
rows.exclusion: Check the input knife change instruction

rows.content: The current knife number is not in the range T 0 to T 8
rows.reason: The current knife number is wrong
rows.exclusion: Reset the knife bank

rows.content: The actual measured tool length is greater than the set longest knife length
rows.reason: The tool exposed length exceeds the allowable length
rows.exclusion: Stop the current machining, replace the tool, and then reprocess

rows.content: Feed shaft servo alarm
rows.reason: Servo drive alarm
rows.exclusion: In automatic mode, reset the machine, clear the alarm, close the machine and restart in 20 seconds, the alarm will automatically clear. After you restart the machine, if the alarm is not cleared, take the servo alarm code content on the interface and send it to the manufacturer.
